metadata.description: PDF creation/extraction libraries plus accessibility and release-quality guidance.
metadata.title: Document PDF - Sources

nodejs_libraries.name: pdf-lib
nodejs_libraries.relevance: Create and modify PDFs in JavaScript/TypeScript (forms, pages, attachments). Upstream (Hopding/pdf-lib) has had no active releases for an extended period as of mid-2026; maintained forks exist (e.g. @cantoo/pdf-lib) — evaluate before depending on it for new work.

nodejs_libraries.name: PDFKit
nodejs_libraries.relevance: Generate PDFs programmatically in Node.js with low-level layout control.

nodejs_libraries.name: Playwright page.pdf()
nodejs_libraries.relevance: Render browser-faithful HTML/CSS to PDF, including print settings such as tagged output and outlines.

python_libraries.name: pypdf Documentation
python_libraries.relevance: Manipulate PDFs in Python (merge/split/rotate, metadata, encryption).

python_libraries.name: pdfplumber
python_libraries.relevance: Extract text/tables from PDFs in Python (OCR-free extraction patterns).

python_libraries.name: ReportLab Documentation
python_libraries.relevance: Generate complex PDFs in Python (tables, charts, pagination).

python_libraries.name: FPDF2 Documentation
python_libraries.relevance: Modern successor to FPDF with Unicode support, improved image handling, HTML rendering.

python_libraries.name: PyMuPDF Documentation
python_libraries.relevance: Low-level PDF/image access for rasterization, image extraction, OCR pipelines, and redaction workflows. Dual-licensed AGPL-3.0/commercial (Artifex) — verify license fit before use in closed-source or SaaS deployments.

python_libraries.name: OCRmyPDF Documentation
python_libraries.relevance: Add searchable OCR text layers to scanned PDFs before downstream extraction or review.

python_libraries.name: WeasyPrint Documentation
python_libraries.relevance: CSS3-based HTML to PDF conversion without browser dependency.

python_libraries.name: Camelot Documentation
python_libraries.relevance: PDF table extraction with Lattice (bordered) and Stream (borderless) modes; 2026 releases (camelot-py 2.x) add an optional neural backend. Use the `camelot-py` package, not the stale `camelot-fork`.

python_libraries.name: pyHanko Documentation
python_libraries.relevance: Digitally sign and validate PDFs using PKCS#12, PKCS#11, and advanced PAdES workflows.

python_libraries.name: PyMuPDF4LLM Documentation
python_libraries.relevance: Extracts PDF content as LLM-ready Markdown with no ML/GPU dependency; uses OCR only when needed. Primary reference for RAG and LLM ingestion pipelines built on PDFs. Built on PyMuPDF, so it inherits the same AGPL-3.0/commercial dual license.

python_libraries.name: PyMuPDF4LLM on PyPI
python_libraries.relevance: Canonical package page for current pymupdf4llm release version and install metadata.

python_libraries.name: Docling (IBM Research) — GitHub
python_libraries.relevance: Production document-extraction library (IBM Research) producing structured DoclingDocument from PDF, DOCX, PPTX, XLSX, HTML, and images. Primary source for releases, issue tracking, and integration examples.

python_libraries.name: Mistral OCR
python_libraries.relevance: OCR API understanding text, tables, equations, and embedded media across document formats. Pricing changes release-over-release (roughly $2-4 per 1,000 pages standard as of mid-2026, ~50% off via batch API) — check https://mistral.ai/pricing at time of use instead of relying on a fixed figure. Docs at https://docs.mistral.ai/

accessibility_and_quality.name: Creating accessible PDFs in Adobe Acrobat
accessibility_and_quality.relevance: Practical PDF accessibility guidance: tagging, reading order, alt text, checks.

accessibility_and_quality.name: Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.2 (W3C Recommendation)
accessibility_and_quality.relevance: Accessibility baseline; relevant when PDFs are used for regulated/enterprise contexts.

accessibility_and_quality.name: EN 301 549 (Accessibility requirements for ICT products and services)
accessibility_and_quality.relevance: Common EU-aligned accessibility requirements referenced in procurement and compliance programs.

accessibility_and_quality.name: PDF/UA (Universal Accessibility) resources
accessibility_and_quality.relevance: PDF accessibility standard and ecosystem resources (useful for understanding tagged PDF requirements).

accessibility_and_quality.name: PDF/A (Archival) resources
accessibility_and_quality.relevance: Archival PDF guidance (PDF/A) for long-term retention and reproducible rendering.

accessibility_and_quality.name: PDF Association
accessibility_and_quality.relevance: Industry resources on PDF standards and accessibility practices (use for deeper dives).

accessibility_and_quality.name: PAC (PDF Accessibility Checker)
accessibility_and_quality.relevance: Practical PDF/UA accessibility validation tool for tagged PDFs.

accessibility_and_quality.name: veraPDF
accessibility_and_quality.relevance: Open-source validator for PDF/A conformance; useful when archiving or compliance requires PDF/A.

accessibility_and_quality.name: Section 508 Document Authoring Guidance
accessibility_and_quality.relevance: US federal guidance for creating accessible documents, including PDFs and source documents that export to PDF.
